decisions.reason: The batch quantity and five-minute deadline do not change the fallback behavior for independently selecting work when assigned tasks are unavailable.
The source changes the current product batch target and deadline, not where task artifacts or supporting links must be stored.
The source does not change how completed subtasks or goal parent tasks must be represented in ClickUp.
The necessary impact is already represented by the same-message MODIFY setting the current batch to 15 products with a five-minute deadline; no additional correction is required.
The necessary impact is already represented by the same-message MODIFY setting the Shopify batch count to 15 and its deadline to within five minutes.
The source concerns the current product batch and does not alter the daily Airbnb outreach cadence or its end-of-day deadline.
The product batch instruction does not change the content bank artifact, intended use, or completion deadline.
The source does not concern the CRM structure document, its visibility, or its required completion location.
The existing rule already requires listing all selected products; changing the selected current batch to 15 does not change that coverage rule or require a separate TikTok-specific state update.
The batch quantity and deadline do not change the spreadsheet structure or its separate TikTok and website tracking fields.
The product batch instruction is unrelated to visibility of shared credentials in Bitwarden.
The source does not modify the responsibility or guidance for advancing interested Airbnb host conversations.
